name: Wave Field
description: A Three.js field of grey points rolling toward the viewer in noise swells. It rises from flat on first view; the pointer lifts the sea and a click drops an accent ripple.
usage: import { ThreeWaveField } from "@/components/design-for-ai/three-wave-field";

props.name: accent
props.description: The one colour in the field: the mound under the pointer and the ring a click or tap drops. Everything else is grey.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Pointer lifts the surface; click or tap drops a ripple.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the host element, which fills its parent.
